recipe.name: Protein-Packed Baked White Beans with Egg and Greens
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Finely chop onion and garlic. Heat olive oil in a small oven-safe skillet over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add tomato paste, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Stir for 1 minute.
Add drained white beans and thawed spinach. Mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
Make a well in the bean mixture and crack both eggs into it.
Sprinkle grated cheddar over the top.
Transfer skillet to the oven and bake for 12-14 minutes until eggs are set to your liking.
Serve hot directly from the skillet.

recipe.name: Chicken Caesar Wrap with Crisp Romaine
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together Greek yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, Dijon mustard, anchovy paste, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Add diced cooked chicken breast to the dressing and toss to coat.
Lay the whole wheat tortilla flat on a clean surface.
Layer the chopped romaine lettuce down the center of the tortilla.
Top with the dressed chicken and sprinkle grated parmesan over it.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from the bottom up to form a wrap.
Slice in half diagonally and serve immediately, or wrap in foil for later.

recipe.name: Korean Gochujang Chicken and Vegetable Tray Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Line a large baking tray with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, whisk together gochujang, sesame oil, low-sodium soy sauce, rice vinegar, minced garlic, and grated ginger to make the marinade.
Place chicken thighs in a bowl, add half the marinade, and toss to coat. Set aside.
On the prepared tray, spread cubed sweet potato, broccoli florets, and sliced red bell pepper. Drizzle with remaining marinade and toss to coat.
Arrange the marinated chicken thighs among the vegetables.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, flipping vegetables and chicken halfway through, until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized.
Serve the chicken and vegetables over a portion of cooked brown rice. Garnish with sliced green onion and toasted sesame seeds.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Mediterranean Veggie Scramble with Feta and Avocado
instructions: Dice red bell pepper and red onion. Roughly chop spinach.
In a bowl, whisk eggs with salt and pepper until frothy.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Sauté bell pepper and onion for 3 minutes until softened.
Add spinach and cook 1 minute until wilted.
Pour in beaten eggs and stir gently with a spatula, folding in the vegetables.
When eggs are nearly set, crumble feta cheese on top and fold briefly.
Toast sourdough bread while eggs finish cooking.
Serve scramble alongside toast and sliced avocado.

recipe.name: Middle Eastern Grilled Lamb Kofta with Tabbouleh and Toum
instructions: Grate onion and squeeze out excess liquid. Finely mince garlic and herbs.
In a bowl, combine ground lamb, grated onion, half the garlic, half the parsley, cilantro, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Mix well and refrigerate 15 minutes.
Divide mixture into 4 portions and shape onto flat skewers or into oval patties.
While lamb rests, make tabbouleh: combine cooked bulgur, finely diced tomato, cucumber, remaining parsley, mint, lemon juice, and 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt.
Prepare toum-style sauce: mash remaining garlic with a pinch of salt, mix with Greek yogurt and a drizzle of olive oil.
Heat a grill pan or outdoor grill to high heat. Grill kofta 4 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Serve kofta with tabbouleh, yogurt sauce, and a sprinkle of sumac.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Vanilla Almond Protein Shake
instructions: Add water, heavy cream, whey protein isolate, almond butter, vanilla extract, and ice cubes to a blender.
Blend on high speed until smooth and creamy, about 30-45 seconds.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
recipe.prep_notes: For best results, chill the water and cream beforehand. Can be prepared in a shaker bottle if blender is unavailable, but blend for smoother texture.

recipe.name: Italian Sausage and Broccoli Rabe Stir Fry
instructions: Wash broccoli rabe and trim tough ends. Blanch in boiling salted water for 2 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add Italian sausage (remove casings if present) and cook, breaking into crumbles, until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add minced garlic and red pepper flakes, stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add blanched broccoli rabe to the skillet and stir fry for 2-3 minutes until tender and well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Remove from heat, sprinkle grated Parmesan cheese on top, and serve hot.
recipe.prep_notes: Blanching the broccoli rabe reduces bitterness. For a milder flavor, substitute with regular broccoli. Can be stored in refrigerator for up to 3 days.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt Bowl with Mixed Nuts, Seeds and Berries
instructions: Divide the Greek yoghurt into two serving bowls.
Top each bowl with almonds, walnuts, pumpkin seeds, and chia seeds.
Add the mixed berries on top.
Drizzle honey over the bowls.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Mediterranean Roasted Chicken Thighs with Root Vegetables and Olives
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F).
In a large bowl, combine the diced potatoes, carrots, red onion, cherry tomatoes, garlic cloves, and kalamata olives.
Add the olive oil, dried oregano, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper. Toss to coat evenly.
Place the chicken thighs on top of the vegetables in a single layer in a roasting pan. Rub the chicken with the lemon juice and a little extra salt and pepper.
Roast for 35–40 minutes, until the chicken skin is golden and crisp and the vegetables are tender, stirring the vegetables halfway through.
Remove from oven, let rest for 5 minutes, and serve the chicken thighs alongside the roasted vegetables.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Smoked Salmon and Chive Frittata
instructions: Whisk eggs and egg whites together with salt and pepper until frothy.
Finely chop chives and flake smoked salmon into small pieces.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and pour in egg mixture.
Scatter smoked salmon and chives evenly over the eggs.
Cook gently for 4-5 minutes until edges are set, then cover and cook another 2-3 minutes until fully set.
Slice and serve warm.

recipe.name: Vietnamese Braised Lemongrass Pork Belly (Thit Kho)
instructions: Cut pork belly and pork shoulder into 2cm cubes. Slice lemongrass finely, mince shallots and garlic.
In a small bowl, mix fish sauce with 2 tablespoons of water to make the braising liquid.
Heat a heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat. Sear pork cubes in batches until golden brown on all sides.
Add shallots, garlic and lemongrass, stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the fish sauce mixture, coconut water and remaining water. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and braise for 45-50 minutes until pork is tender and sauce has reduced slightly.
Remove from heat and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Smoky Baked Beans with Poached Eggs and Cheddar
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sauté diced onion for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and smoked paprika, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato passata, molasses, and apple cider vinegar. Simmer for 2 minutes.
Add cooked cannellini beans and salt. Stir and cook for 5 minutes until beans are hot and sauce thickens slightly.
In a separate pot of simmering water, poach the eggs for 3-4 minutes until whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Toast the whole wheat bread.
Serve the smoky beans in a bowl, top with poached eggs and shredded cheddar cheese. Serve with toast on the side.

recipe.name: BBQ Beef Brisket Curry with Cornbread
instructions: Cut beef brisket into 2-inch chunks and season with salt.
In a Dutch oven over medium-high heat, sear beef brisket on all sides until browned. Remove and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. Add diced onion and red bell pepper, cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic, chipotle peppers, tomato paste, mustard powder, and cayenne pepper. Stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in beef broth, molasses, and apple cider vinegar. Scrape the bottom of the pot to deglaze.
Return beef to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45 minutes until beef is tender and sauce thickens.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 190°C.
For cornbread: In a bowl, mix cornmeal, flour, baking powder, and salt. In another bowl, whisk melted butter, buttermilk, and egg. Combine wet and dry ingredients.
Pour cornbread batter into a greased small baking dish. Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown on top.
Serve the BBQ brisket curry hot with a slice of cornbread on the side.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Fluffy Egg White Omelette with Cheese and Herbs
instructions: Separate egg whites from whole eggs, combine all egg whites and the whole egg in a bowl, whisk until frothy.
Season with salt and pepper, fold in finely chopped chives.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until foaming.
Pour egg mixture into the skillet, let cook undisturbed for 1 minute until edges set.
Sprinkle shredded gruyere cheese over one half of the omelette.
Fold the other half over the cheese, cook for another 30 seconds until cheese melts.
Slide onto plate and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Cajun Blackened Catfish with Roasted Okra and Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Pat catfish fillet dry and coat generously with Cajun seasoning on both sides.
Heat 1 tablespoon ghee in a cast iron skillet over high heat until shimmering.
Sear catfish for 2 minutes per side until blackened crust forms, then remove from skillet.
Toss okra (halved lengthwise), sliced red bell pepper, and smashed garlic cloves in remaining ghee with salt.
Spread vegetables on the skillet, place catfish on top, and roast for 12 minutes until fish flakes easily.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the dish and serve immediately.
